 Mitutoyo
Mitutoyo 
Mitutoyo microscopes and industrial metrology products have been manufactured to meet high quality standards for over 80 years. The company was started with a single product (the micrometer) in 1934 and remains a family owned Japanese company today. Mitutoyo products are manufactured in Japan and are known for their high quality, precision and durability.
